messages:
sara (product): FYI incoming private deploy request from LyraHealth — they want VPC + on‑prem bundle, air-gapped, HSM for key management. Target go-live ~3 weeks. Can we do a quick feasibility + blockers list? @matt @ada @jordan
matt (eng-infra): noted. quick Qs: multi-AZ requirement? GPU type? do they have an infra diagram?
jordan (solutions): customer says 10 racks at a single colo, asking for 4x A100-class nodes + 2 management VMs. I can drop the topology after the sync.
ada (eng-ml): main risks: model memory / KV cache under airgap, and quantization validation. We'll likely need quantized model variant and >=256GB host RAM for sharded runtime. HSM key unwrap integration is doable but needs ops work.
deploy-bot: New deploy request created: LR-4723 — https://redwood.internal/tickets/LR-4723 :white_check_mark:
sara (product): TL;DR blockers: network egress policy, HSM vendor integration, cert provisioning, install window, and license/compliance signoffs. Proposal: 3-phase rollout — 1) infra + network prep (1 week), 2) private control plane + model deploy (1 week), 3) validation + handover (>=1 week).
lina (security): Need SOC2 evidence from colo + encryption-at-rest policy on their storage. Which HSM vendor are they using? Yubico vs cloud HSM? Send vendor details. Also require a key rotation plan and attestation steps.
matt (eng-infra): Timeline is aggressive but not impossible if colo can prestage racks. Need static IPs and either BGP cross-connect or IPsec VPN. Customer prefers direct cross-connect. Also confirm power density and kW per rack.
jordan (solutions): Confirmed cross-connect is possible. Customer wants minimal outbound: only 443 to our control plane. Any blockers with that?
ada (eng-ml): Control plane reachability is required for model rollout and metrics. We can support one-directional connections with mTLS; alternative is an on-prem control component if they insist on no outbound at all. Recommend mTLS to keep it simple.
sales-jane: Customer has budget and is ready to sign Dedicated contract pending feasibility. Flag any line-items that are outside standard pricing (e.g., HSM integration, custom networking).
sara (product): Action items: - matt: produce network + rack checklist + lead times - ada: model quantization plan, offline inference fallback, and test run - lina: security accept criteria + HSM vendor checklist - jordan: upload customer infra diagram + cross-connect confirmation.
matt (eng-infra): I'll post the checklist by EOD. Preliminary blockers: power density, remote KVM access for provisioning, and firewall rules for mTLS cert bootstrap.
ada (eng-ml): Estimating quantize+validation + perf tests ~3 days. I'll prepare a minimal run sample for onsite sanity: ```docker run redwood/edge-runtime --model=lyra-13b-q4 --mode=local-test```
sara (product): Great. Let's do a sign-off sync 11:00 PT tomorrow to lock scope and timeline. If anything blocks before then, ping this thread. :thumbsup:
